title: Google rebuilt access after being breached in 2009
body: Operation Aurora's intrusion convinced Google that the corporate network perimeter was fiction, leading to BeyondCorp: every access is authenticated by user and device identity regardless of network location, the zero-trust template. The castle-and-moat model assumed insiders were safe, in the decade VPNs became the moat-rope. Modern zero trust is that breach's architectural scar tissue.
